# Modding Sunrise

> Sunrise is Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 in Rust. A mod is one `.smod`: content (`assets/`, `data/`) and, for a code mod, a Rust crate built natively by `cargo sunrise-mod build` (and started by `cargo sunrise-mod run`), against the `mod_api` crate (`sunrise-mod-api`).

Rules for code: implement `mod_api::Hooks` at the crate root with `#[mod_api::sunrise_mod]`; prefer a hook or Part method; change the game's own code only through the native route (`[[native.mixin]]`, `[[native.loop]]`, `[[native.bridge]]`, `[[native.module]]`). Hook names follow NeoForge 26.3; events are `&mut`; writes take a `ServerHost`. The id and version come only from `sunrise-mod.toml`; ids are `[a-z0-9_]`. A code mod declares `[native]`; unknown manifest fields are refused.

## Getting started

- [Using an AI agent](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/for-agents): the install and quickstart commands and the rules, on one page.
- [Install the mod tool](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/start/install-tool): the prebuilt `cargo-sunrise-mod` for Linux, macOS and Windows.
- [Installing and using mods](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/players/installing-mods)
- [Your first content mod](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/start/first-content-mod)
- [Your first native mod](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/start/first-mod)
- [Writing hooks](https://playsunrise.net/docs/modding/start/writing-hooks): the crate root, events, hosts and listener order.
